name: @oi4/oi4-oec-service-demo-go
description: An OI4-compliant demo application in Go showing the publishing of data
author: Open Industry 4.0 Alliance - Community

scripts.lint: golangci-lint run ./... --enable-all -D tagliatelle -D depguard -D goimports -D gofumpt -D gci -D paralleltest -D exhaustruct -D godot -D testpackage -D godox
scripts.docker:build: yarn run prepareContainer && docker buildx build --push --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7,linux/arm/v6 -t oi4a/oi4-oec-service-demo-go:${npm_package_version} -t oi4a/oi4-oec-service-demo-go:latest .
scripts.docker:build:snapshot: yarn run prepareContainer && docker build -t oi4a/oi4-oec-service-demo-go:${npm_package_version} -t oi4a/oi4-oec-service-demo-go:latest --build-arg BUILD_ENV=snapshot .
